title: AIRNET: A Computer Program for Building Airflow Network Modeling
publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology

license.name: United States government work; NIST public-domain software documentation

measurement_uncertainty.description: AIRNET Appendix B contains software verification cases and inter-program comparisons rather than measurement data.

known_gaps: AIRNET solves pressure-driven network flow while NexusEP currently prescribes balanced mixing flows.
Pressure-drop and buoyancy-doorway results cannot verify NexusEP until a compatible pressure-network formulation exists.
The report predates the current CONTAM implementation and is used for transparent historical verification cases only.

preprocessing.description: Verify the exact public NIST AIRNET report PDF by signature, byte size, and SHA-256 without creating a derived dataset.

permitted_use.purpose: Analytical and comparative airflow-network verification planning
permitted_use.notes: The source is a United States government publication. NexusEP still requires source attribution for scientific traceability.
